claims: Cuts token usage 'by up to 70%' (title card says 'saves millions in tokens')
Uploading PDFs/PowerPoint/Word/Excel/images eats context; markdown is far easier for LLMs to ingest
The MCP integration converts files to markdown before Claude processes them
how_to_steps: Convert PDF/PPTX/DOCX/XLSX/images to .md before feeding them to the LLM
Optionally add the MarkItDown MCP server to Claude so conversion happens automatically
on_screen_only: Title card: 'FREE MICROSOFT TOOL SAVES MILLIONS IN TOKENS'

relevance.why: A solo founder constantly feeds PDFs/decks/spreadsheets to Claude Code; pre-converting to markdown is a real token and quality win and the tool is free, from Microsoft, and has an MCP server.

implement_score.why: pip install markitdown and either a CLI pre-step or the markitdown-mcp server in Claude Code's MCP config. Under 30 minutes. Only caveat: verify the '70%' figure yourself on real files.
